name: Jihakuzai PX-14
source:
Kouichi, a teacher in his second year, and...

Fine arts tutor Mamiko.
English tutor Maria.
Headmistress Elvira.

Plus the unpopular gym teacher, Shirakawa.

At the start of summer vacation, changes in each human relationship appear...

Triggered by a tasteless and odorless liquid.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ074054.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
光一，一名二年级教师，还有……

美术导师真美子。
英语导师玛丽亚.
校长埃尔维拉.

再加上不受欢迎的体育老师白川。

暑假伊始，各种人际关系都出现了变化……

由无味无臭的液体触发。
